question: Who founded the Prarthana Samaj?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Atmaram Pandurang**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Atmaram Pandurang** was the founder of the **Prarthana Samaj**, established in **1867** in Bombay (now Mumbai).
 
• The Prarthana Samaj was influenced by the ideas of the **Brahmo Samaj** and focused on **social and religious reform**.
 
• It emphasized **monotheism** and opposed idol worship and caste discrimination.
 
• Atmaram Pandurang was supported by prominent leaders like **Justice Mahadev Govind Ranade** in propagating the ideals of the Prarthana Samaj.
 
• The movement aimed at creating a society based on rational thought, equality, and ethical principles, paving the way for modern reformist ideologies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Brahmo Samaj:** Founded by **Raja Ram Mohan Roy** in 1828, it laid the foundation for religious and social reform movements in India.
 
• **Justice Mahadev Govind Ranade:** A key figure in the Prarthana Samaj, Ranade worked towards abolishing caste discrimination and promoting women’s education and widow remarriage.
 
• **Social Reform Movements:** The Prarthana Samaj was part of a broader reformist wave in 19th century India aimed at eradicating social evils like untouchability, child marriage, and gender inequality.
 
• **Religious Philosophy:** The Samaj advocated a rational approach to religion, promoting ethical living and humanitarian values over ritualistic practices.
 
• **Legacy:** The efforts of the Prarthana Samaj contributed significantly to the modernization of Indian society and the spread of progressive ideas during the colonial era.
